definitions.explanation: A discolored mark on the skin caused by an injury where blood vessels are damaged beneath the surface.
A colored mark on the skin that is present from birth or appears shortly after.

examples.english: I got a bruise on my arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぶつけた→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧あざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: A large bruise remains where I bumped it.

examples.japanese: あざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧くらい⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took about a week for the bruise to disappear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|う}まれつき→生まれつき：21201_umaretsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many babies have birthmarks on their backs.

examples.japanese: {蒙古斑|もうこはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧あざ⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{消|き}える→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: Mongolian spots look like blue birthmarks but fade as the child grows.

notes: Can be written in kanji as {痣|あざ}, but the kana form is more common. The typical verb pattern is あざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (a bruise forms) rather than あざ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく. For bruises, {青|あお}あざ (blue bruise) is a common compound. In medical contexts, birthmarks may be further classified by color: {青|あお}あざ, {赤|あか}あざ, ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧あざ, etc.
